plan.notes: Source: Alexandria Technical & Community College 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF, updated August 25, 2025), 'Economics Transfer Pathway' Associate of Arts degree course sequence, PROGRAM CREDITS: 60. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. The catalog states: 'AA Degrees must have general education courses from all 10 goal areas of the MN Transfer Curriculum.' and 'This course sequence is an example. Visit with advisor or refer to Degree Audit Report for elective options.' The MNTC slots are goal-specific choice slots; see advisor or Degree Audit Report for course options. The catalog does not list prerequisites in the sequence.
